name: descriptive_statistics
description: Federated descriptive statistics (counts, minmax, mean, std, nrows, nans, outliers) over arbitrary columns

functions.name: central
functions.description: Compute descriptive statistics for one or more columns across every participating node, combined to the exact pooled value.

arguments.name: statistics
arguments.description: Per-column statistics to compute: {column: {stats: [...], bins, min_cap, max_cap, inliers}}. Valid stats: counts, binned_counts, minmax, mean, std, nrows, nans, outliers.

arguments.name: filters
arguments.description: Row filters applied before every statistic: equality, isin, or a {gte,gt,lte,lt} range.

arguments.name: organizations
arguments.description: Organization names to include; omit for every organization.

arguments.name: min_organizations
arguments.description: Quorum: fewer qualifying organizations is a clean QUORUM_NOT_MET error.

arguments.name: min_rows
arguments.description: Per-node floor on usable rows (after filters); below it, the node is excluded entirely. Defaults to the repo-wide privacy default (5).

arguments.name: min_cell_count
arguments.description: Minimum count to release a cell/category unsuppressed. Defaults to the repo-wide privacy default (5).

arguments.name: max_categories
arguments.description: Categories beyond the most frequent this many are merged into "<other>". Defaults to the repo-wide privacy default (20).

arguments.name: timeout_s
arguments.description: Seconds to wait for each node before it's marked TIMEOUT.
